summary: No candidate survives chemical review. In this gas-phase model the main CH2CCH route is limited by C2H4 supply; closing the deficit in the gas phase would need more C2H4 or a secondary route (CCH + CH3) ~1000x faster than KIDA's uncertainty allows. Missing grain chemistry is the candidate explanation (hypothesis).
